# Vendored libraries

Copied verbatim (import paths adjusted) because they are small, stable and
deterministic, and pinning their exact source keeps the engine's golden hashes
stable. Both are ISC-licensed; the licence texts are alongside.

| Files           | Origin                               | Version                         |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| `delaunator.js` | https://github.com/mapbox/delaunator | 4.0.1 (dependency-free release) |

Do not edit these files; replace them wholesale when upgrading and update the
golden hashes deliberately.
